announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $2,293,000,000 cost-plus-incentive-fee indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide initial non-recurring sustainment activities and services, including site activation, interim contractor support, fleet management, and reliability and maintainability improvement plan in support of establishing new operational sites, one-time setup of both land-based and at-sea fleet support operations including initial engineering and technical sustainment services the F-35 Lightning II Joint Strike Fighter Air Systems for the Air Force, Marine Corps, Navy, Foreign Military Sales customers, and F-35 Cooperative Program Partners. Work will be performed in Fort Worth, Texas (85%); and Orlando, Florida (15%), and is expected to be completed in December 2028. No funds will be obligated at the time of award; funds will be obligated on individual orders as they are issued. This contract action was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N0001926D0010).

announcements.text: Sikorsky Aircraft Corp., a Lockheed Martin Co., Stratford, Connecticut, is awarded a not-to-exceed $525,000,000 firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, cost reimbursable indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide highly specialized non-recurring engineering, integration, and flight-test support for the development and modernization of the Y/CH-53K Heavy Lift Helicopter program. Efforts include the design, development, testing, verification, and validation of product improvements, as well as the integration and qualification of advanced technologies to enhance aircraft capability, performance, and reliability for the Marine Corps, Navy and a Foreign Military Sales customer. Work will be performed in Stratford, Connecticut (65.2%); West Palm Beach, Florida (19.93%); Fort Worth, Texas (4.79%); Trumbull, Connecticut (3.16%); King of Prussia, Pennsylvania (1.43%); Rochester, Minnesota (1.12%); and various locations within the continental U.S. (4.37%), and is expected to be completed in June 2031. No funds will be obligated at the time of award; funds will be obligated on individual orders as they are issued. This contract action was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N0001926D1005).

announcements.text: Krempp Construction Inc.* Jasper, Indiana, is awarded a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N4008526-D-0013) with a maximum amount of $45,000,000 for magazine maintenance and repairs at Naval Weapons Station Crane. Work will be performed at Crane, Indiana. The term of the contract is not to exceed 60 months with an expected completion date of June 2031. Fiscal 2026 working capital (Army) contract funds in the amount of $2,500 are obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured via Sam.gov, with one offer received. Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Mid-Atlantic, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Eiffage Infraestructuras SAU, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0001); UTE Programa, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0002); Sociedad Espanola de Montajes Industriales SA, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0003); Elecnor Servicios y Proyectos SAU, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0004); JJEX Construction JV LLC, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0005); Dragados Sociedad Anonima, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0006); and Cox T&I SL, Sevilla, Spain (FA5575-26-D-0007), were awarded a maximum $400,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity multiple-award construction contract supporting Morón Air Base, Spain. This contract provides for a broad range of design-build, sustainment, maintenance, repair, alteration, renovation, and minor construction projects. Work will be performed at Morón de la Frontera, Sevilla, Spain, and is expected to be completed by June 11, 2036. These contracts were competitive acquisitions and thirteen offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $35,000 are being obligated at time of award. The 496th Air Base Squadron, Morón Air Base, Morón de la Frontera, Sevilla, Spain, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Nextgen Federal, Morgantown, West Virginia, has been awarded a ceiling $14,081,185 cost-type contract for the Enterprise Environmental Portal E2P, named BIFROST. This contract provides for integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning to assist with workflow management, command and control, and production of weather products. Work will be performed at Morgantown, West Virginia, and is expected to be completed by June 21, 2030. This contract was a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance and research and development funds in the amount of $1,475,062 are being obligated at time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts, is the contracting activity (FA2330-26-C-B007). (Awarded May 22, 2026)

The Defense Finance and Accounting Service, Contract Services Directorate, Columbus, Ohio, is the contracting activity (HQ042325FE049).
